hints.title: Split by Spaces
hints.text: Break the input string into individual words separated by spaces.

hints.title: Check Word Length
hints.text: For words with length 1 or 2, convert all characters to lowercase. For longer words, capitalize the first letter and make the rest lowercase.

hints.title: Recombine with Single Space
hints.text: Join the formatted words back into a single string separated by spaces.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution

complexity.time: O(N) single pass or optimal algorithmic traversal
variables: N: input size or row count
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating character by character without recognizing word boundaries leads to complex index tracking.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Splitting and rejoining requires O(N) time and O(N) space for intermediate word lists.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handle case transitions cleanly and maintain single space delimiters.
